title: Validate and display design options
responsibility: Check image ownership across design options and convert their metadata for display.

inputs.name: hubImageOption.value
inputs.description: Design version whose option ownership is queried.

inputs.name: hubOptionInfos.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubOptionInfos.base
inputs.description: Folder prefix to prepend to option prompt filenames.

inputs.name: hubOptionInfos.value
inputs.description: Design version whose option display metadata is needed.

inputs.name: hubRevision.value
inputs.description: Design version with an optional earlier-image revision source.

outputs.name: hubOptions
outputs.description: Original version after checking sequential option IDs, exact one-time image ownership, distinct trimmed/case-folded directions and no shared hash across options; single designs pass through.

outputs.name: hubImageOption
outputs.description: Object naming the owning option, or an empty object.

outputs.name: hubOptionInfos
outputs.description: Optional displayed options with verified prompt text, direction, revised prompt, generator label and image hashes.

outputs.name: hubRevision
outputs.description: Optional revision target with earlier version, image hash, region, thread and option.
